decidir.libertados: {{valor}} released for payment. The obligation was created in Finance.
decidir.rejeitada_toast: Invoice rejected. It creates no obligation.
decidir.nao_conferida: This invoice has not been reconciled yet. Reconcile it before releasing it for payment — approving without reconciling is signing a blank cheque.
decidir.vai_ser_criada: An obligation will be created for

excepcoes.vazio_texto: Cases appear here when a reconciliation finds discrepancies above the configured tolerance.
excepcoes.motivo_dispensa: Waiving requires writing why — it is recorded as a waiver, not as a resolution.
excepcoes.motivo_decisao: This decision requires a written reason.
excepcoes.encerrado: This case is closed and does not reopen. If new information has appeared, reconcile the invoice again — that replaces the assessment and opens new cases.
excepcoes.dispensar_b: resolving it — legitimate for a deviation that costs more to dispute than to pay. It is recorded as a waiver and not as a resolution: they are different things, and the audit needs to tell them apart.
excepcoes.placeholder_decisao: Supplier issued a credit note for the difference.

registar.erro_carregar_pedido: Could not load the order lines.
registar.erro_linhas: Add at least one line with a description and quantity.
registar.registada: Invoice registered. It stays under analysis until it is reconciled.
registar.subtitulo: It stays under analysis until it is reconciled.

sessao.vai_somando: It adds up as you unload — with no expected quantity shown
sessao.aviso_zero: A product left at 0 is treated as not received. On finishing, the system records the goods receipt with what was counted and compares it against the invoice.
sessao.contar_primeiro: Count at least one product before finishing
sessao.bate_certo: What was counted matches the invoice.

tolerancias.removida: Tolerance removed. This dimension goes back to zero tolerance.
tolerancias.sem_politica: With no policy, tolerance is zero
tolerancias.sem_politica_b: — not infinite. Any deviation opens a case. This is deliberate: a missing configuration must not result in a lack of control.
tolerancias.regra_a: The most specific rule prevails, and policies
tolerancias.regra_c: : the most specific one applies in full, per dimension.
tolerancias.vazio_texto: All dimensions are at zero tolerance: any difference between the invoice, the order and the goods receipt opens a case.
tolerancias.erro_escopo_id: Specify which {{escopo}} this tolerance applies to.
tolerancias.erro_limite: Set at least one limit. For zero tolerance, do not create any policy — its absence already means zero.
tolerancias.basta_um: It is enough for either one to accommodate the deviation for it to pass.
